title: IPLD test vectors are stability oracles regenerated from the code under test
description: core/ipld/test_vectors.rs:44-56: the DAG-CBOR stability oracle values are byte-for-byte records from build_article(), not from an independent reference implementation (Python dag-cbor, js dag-json, ipfs-car, etc.). A change to ArticleRootNode schema silently makes the test meaningless because the developer must re-record the constants from the same code that just changed. The comment says 're-record only after verifying the change is intentional' but there is no enforcement. Fix: cross-validate against a committed reference output produced by an independent implementation (Python serde_cbor or dag-cbor CLI). CLAUDE.md test-integrity rules require an independent oracle.
